auxiliary_format_retries: Reviewer-only; do not create candidates. Every code revision consumes a candidate attempt.
attempt_definition: Initial candidate plus all candidate revisions; at most six. No hidden syntax/code retries.
witness_policy: Only schema-derived synthetic empty-target runtime probe; no evaluation fixtures.
output_policy: New outputs/experiments/<experiment_id>; destination must not exist.
prefix_policy: Identical initial prompts/settings/transitions; budgets never appear in prompts. First accepted within prefix; no acceptance => NO_VERDICT. Never select on evaluation scores.
